# Stellar Global Supplies

> Pune-based B2B supplier of stainless steel, mild steel and industrial fastening products. Buyers can review product information and request quotations by sharing their specifications.

- [Homepage](https://stellarglobalsupplies.com/)
- [Promotional products](https://stellarglobalsupplies.com/promotional-products/)
- [Industrial supplies blog](https://stellarglobalsupplies.com/blog/)

## Procurement

- Request a quotation with material grade, size, quantity, application and delivery location.
- Confirm specification, availability, pricing, delivery terms and required documents before placing an order.
- Use the product pages and buyer guides to shortlist requirements; they are not substitutes for drawings or engineering approval.
